items.title: Why Is Marvell Technology Stock Falling 5% Today?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) shares fell 5% in premarket trading on Tuesday, reversing part of Monday’s gain of more than 18% as semiconductor stocks retreated and Susquehanna lowered its price target for the company. Concerns surrounding the valuation of Marvell’s proposed acquisition of Lumentum, potential shareholder dilution and broader market weakness also weighed on investor sentiment.
